section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section focuses on the factor structure of the Indonesian version of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), noting a two-dimensional structure in contrast to Western samples but consistent with other non-Western samples. The study found that men had significantly higher positive body appreciation than women, and general body appreciation was negatively correlated with BMI. Limitations, including opportunistic sampling and the lack of additional body image measures, are acknowledged.
